rca_of_issue: **Backend ObjectId Bug (FIXED)**: Budget creation endpoint was returning MongoDB document with _id field which is not JSON serializable. Root cause: Line 505 returned budget_dict directly which included MongoDB _id. Fix: Explicitly construct return object excluding _id. **Frontend Transactions Buttons**: Buttons with testIDs 'add-txn-btn' and 'sms-parse-btn' not found in DOM when checking programmatically, despite being defined in transactions.tsx. Possible causes: (1) React Native web rendering issue with TouchableOpacity, (2) testID not being converted to data-testid in web preview, (3) Component not mounting properly. Needs deeper investigation. **Insights Loading**: Screen shows spinner but content doesn't load - API call may be timing out or failing silently.
